Class IceTower

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Tower
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.towers.IceTower
Direct Known Subclasses:
J2dIceTower
public abstract class IceTower extends Tower
A support tower that slows all enemies within its range.

Default stats:

  • range: 3.0 game-world units
  • damage: 0 (no direct damage)
  • fire rate: 0 (does not fire projectiles — uses an area effect instead)
  • cost: 75 gold
  • slow factor: 0.4 (enemies in range move at 40% of normal speed)
  • slow duration: 0.3 seconds (how long the slow lasts after leaving range)
  • size: 0.8 × 0.8 units

Mechanic: unlike the arrow and cannon towers, the ice tower never fires a projectile. Instead the game loop calls applyAreaEffect(List) every frame, which calls enemy.applySlow(slowFactor, slowDuration) for each enemy in range. The slowTimer in Enemy ensures the effect expires after the enemy leaves range.

Abstract because render() from Entity is not implemented here; J2dIceTower extends this class and implements it.

  • Method Details

    • applyAreaEffect

      public void applyAreaEffect(List<Enemy> enemies)
      Slows every alive enemy within this tower's range.

      Called by the game loop each frame instead of the normal fire/projectile flow. enemy.applySlow() refreshes the slow timer, so as long as an enemy stays in range it remains slowed; once it leaves, speed returns to normal after slowDuration seconds.

      Streams usage: filter keeps alive enemies within range, then forEach applies the slow to each one.

      Overrides:
      applyAreaEffect in class Tower
      Parameters:
      enemies - the current list of enemies

      public Projectile fire(EntityFactory factory, Enemy target)
